column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a desolate height” renders an uncertain word that may mean “a bare height.”
Close to the Hebrew; “oracle” renders “mashal” (a proverb or parable; also in verse 18).
Close to the Hebrew; “one-fourth” is how NKJV reads a word that others take as “dust cloud,” and “the righteous” renders “the upright ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord” is supplied; the Hebrew says only “while I meet there.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “a King.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wild ox” renders “re'em.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the wasteland” renders “Jeshimon,” possibly a place name.
